verdict.rationale: MotherDuck Flights run scheduled Python jobs for ingest and transformation inside the platform, with the runtime, scheduling, secrets, logging, and versioning managed for you. That roughly covers the 'tasks' part of the story. Declarative pipelines rely on the external dbt-duckdb adapter rather than a native in-platform feature. Missing for 10: native streams or change-data-capture, continuous queries, built-in incremental or declarative pipeline primitives, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of Flights.
